body:
## Context

Parent epic #3229 shipped dispatcher-backed epic run-state, minimal worker context packs, TCD dispatch planning, and lifecycle planning. Its bounded pilot (#3701, #3707, #3710) selected inline execution for all three slices and started zero implementation workers, but retained a long-lived Sol coordinator context. Model inquiry `inq_20260715T091433Z_ea8a849b` reached consensus that the next slice must measure this trade-off before any automatic rotation or worker policy is introduced.

## Scope

- Add a versioned context-budget receipt to dispatcher-backed epic run-state.
- Add a deterministic evaluator invoked at slice boundaries in advisory/shadow mode.
- Emit independent coordinator lifecycle (`keep` or `checkpoint_rotate`) and slice execution (`inline` or `thin_worker`) recommendations, plus a model-tier recommendation and reasons.
- Represent unavailable context/token measurements explicitly as `unknown`, including their measurement source.
- Persist a slice-boundary checkpoint/digest containing slice status, decision-log delta, open review findings, and an external-state marker/refresh requirement.
- Record cost-per-accepted-slice inputs when available: model/token cost, tool and wait cost/time, failed attempts, implementation/CI/review repairs, handoffs/worker starts, and human minutes. Missing values remain `unknown`; no values are fabricated.
- Preserve the #3229 pilot observations as a replay fixture without claiming that its long-lived Sol coordinator was cheapest.
- Update the Builder System owner docs for the shipped advisory receipt/evaluator contract.

## Source Anchors

- `#3229 :: dispatcher-backed epic runner acceptance and bounded pilot`
- `#3701 :: pilot dispatch truth and ProjectV2 pickup correction`
- `#3707 :: latest-check lifecycle truth`
- `#3710 :: truthful terminal blocker reporting`
- `app/builderops/epic_run_state.py :: schema and idempotent run-state updates`
- `app/builderops/epic_dispatch.py :: dry-run TCD dispatch decisions and minimal context packs`
- `app/builderops/epic_lifecycle_plan.py :: advisory lifecycle planning and gate invariants`
- `docs/AGENT_ISSUE_DISPATCHER.md :: Epic-runner lifecycle planning`
- `docs/development/BUILDER_SYSTEM_PROCESS_MAP.md :: Dispatcher And Routing Model`

## SBS Impact

- Primary subsystem: Builder System / CES boundary
- Secondary subsystem(s): none for Product/Runtime behavior
- Write class: governance/docs/process and local Builder System tooling
- Authority impact: adds advisory Builder System coordination evidence only; GitHub Issues/PRs/CI, independent review, merge, and closure keep their existing authority
- Persistence impact: versioned, discardable local epic run-state receipts plus repo-governed code, tests, and owner docs
- Derived/rebuildable impact: receipts and checkpoints are coordination evidence and must not outrank live GitHub/repo/dispatcher truth; missing measurements remain explicit
- Human knowledge impact: none
- Memory impact: none; Builder telemetry does not enter Product/runtime or user memory
- Retrieval/context impact: observes coordinator context pressure and records bounded slice digests without rotating or compressing context
- Sync/deployment impact: none; local Builder System tooling only
- External boundary impact: records externally supplied Issue/PR/SHA/CI/review markers without introducing new reads or writes to those systems
- New or changed contract: advisory context-budget receipt, independent coordinator/slice recommendations, slice-boundary checkpoint/digest, and truthful cost-per-accepted-slice measurement
- Owner-doc impact: will-update-in-PR for `docs/AGENT_ISSUE_DISPATCHER.md` and `docs/development/BUILDER_SYSTEM_PROCESS_MAP.md`
- Transition debt impact: reduces D12 by making context, repair, handoff, and human-cost signals explicit; preserves D11 by keeping the evaluator advisory and outside Product SBS authority
- Fitness rule impact: strengthens focused BuilderOps run-state and advisory/no-bypass regression coverage; no new universal threshold rule

## Constraints

- Advisory/shadow mode only: recommendations must not rotate or terminate a coordinator, start a worker, change dispatch, add parallelism, mutate CI/review/closure state, or mark a slice accepted.
- Keep coordinator lifecycle, slice execution, and model-tier recommendations orthogonal.
- Do not encode universal fixed thresholds from the three-slice pilot; any evaluator policy inputs must be explicit and versioned.
- External-state change requires checkpoint refresh/validation evidence but does not alone force rotation.
- Do not weaken, merge, or bypass CI, independent review, merge, or closure gates.
- Do not add coordinator fencing, rehydration, automatic compression, automatic rotation, or automatic worker launch.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Dispatcher-backed run-state round-trips a versioned context-budget receipt without losing existing lifecycle or coordination state.
  - Verify: `tests/builderops/test_epic_run_context_budget.py::test_context_budget_round_trips_in_run_state`
- [ ] The evaluator emits coordinator lifecycle (`keep`/`checkpoint_rotate`) and slice execution (`inline`/`thin_worker`) as independent deterministic decisions.
  - Verify: `tests/builderops/test_epic_run_context_budget.py::test_lifecycle_and_execution_decisions_are_independent`
- [ ] Missing token/context measurements are `unknown` and cannot be interpreted as low pressure or zero cost.
  - Verify: `tests/builderops/test_epic_run_context_budget.py::test_unknown_context_measurement_does_not_mean_low_pressure`
- [ ] A #3229 pilot replay preserves the three observed inline routes and zero implementation-worker starts without claiming that long-lived Sol was cheapest.
  - Verify: `tests/builderops/test_epic_run_context_budget.py::test_3229_pilot_replay_preserves_observed_routes`
- [ ] A slice-boundary checkpoint contains status, decision-log delta, open review findings, and an external-state marker; changed external state requires refresh but does not unconditionally force rotation.
  - Verify: `tests/builderops/test_epic_run_context_budget.py::test_slice_boundary_checkpoint_requires_refresh_not_unconditional_rotation`
- [ ] Advisory recommendations cannot mutate dispatch, start agents, mark acceptance, or bypass existing CI, independent review, and closure gates.
  - Verify: `tests/builderops/test_epic_run_context_budget.py::test_context_routing_cannot_bypass_acceptance_gates`
- [ ] Cost-per-accepted-slice includes available cost/time inputs, failed attempts, repairs, handoffs, worker starts, and human minutes while preserving unavailable inputs as `unknown` and never fabricating a denominator.
  - Verify: `tests/builderops/test_epic_run_context_budget.py::test_cost_per_accepted_slice_includes_repairs_handoffs_and_unknowns`
- [ ] Owner docs describe the shipped evaluator as observer-only coordination evidence and retain live GitHub/dispatcher/CI/review/closure authority boundaries.
  - Verify: doc writeback at `docs/AGENT_ISSUE_DISPATCHER.md :: Epic-runner context-budget observation`
  - Verify: doc writeback at `docs/development/BUILDER_SYSTEM_PROCESS_MAP.md :: Dispatcher And Routing Model`

## Out of Scope

- Automatic coordinator rotation, termination, compression, or session rehydration.
- Automatic worker/subagent start, new parallelism, or dispatch-policy changes.
- Fixed universal thresholds derived from the #3229 pilot.
- Coordinator single-writer fencing or rotation handoff mechanics.
- Weakening or combining CI, independent review, merge, or closure gates.

## Suggested Validation

- `pytest -q tests/builderops/test_epic_run_context_budget.py`
- `pytest -q tests/builderops/test_epic_run_state.py tests/builderops/test_epic_dispatch.py tests/builderops/test_epic_lifecycle_plan.py tests/builderops/test_ci_handoff_state.py`
- `ruff check app tests`
- `mypy app`
- `pytest -q -m "not pg"`
- `python3 scripts/docs_guard.py`
- `git diff --check`

## Source Docs

- `docs/AGENT_ISSUE_DISPATCHER.md`
- `docs/development/BUILDER_SYSTEM_PROCESS_MAP.md`
- `docs/development/DEV_WORKFLOW.md`
- `docs/architecture/SBS_OPERATING_MODEL.md`
- `docs/architecture/SBS_TRANSITION_DEBT.md`
- `.codex/skills/deliver-issue-set/SKILL.md`
- `.codex/skills/issue-to-code/SKILL.md`
- `.codex/skills/verification-and-closure/SKILL.md`

## Applies learning (optional)

- Accepted model inquiry `inq_20260715T091433Z_ea8a849b` (consensus; accepted artifact hash `5220ce7195ee976bfb3733853e2ef43c4b16f7d8747cc0d1b7e938d93d5d07af`).
- Contract-shape repair: canonical inquiry readiness returned `needs_input` because the accepted proposal omitted `## Source Docs`; this issue adds the missing canonical sections without expanding the accepted implementation scope.
- BuilderOps PromotionIntent `prom_20260715095030_fee8133d` records the explicit authority crossing into this GitHub Issue.
